title: Planning Session Log
description: Tracks plan-architect sessions: design doc conversion, user edits, design deviations, and plan file creation. Enables plan modification by recording the edit trail that produced the final plan. Used by orchestrator (session awareness), plan-architect (state tracking/handoff), and future plan modification sessions.

examples: batch-selector
recipe-processor

started_at.description: ISO timestamp when planning session started

completed_at.description: ISO timestamp when planning completed (null if in progress)

session_id.description: Claude Code session ID for tracking and hook matching

source_design_doc.description: Path to the design document being converted to a plan
examples: .claude/designs/batch-selector.md
.claude/designs/recipe-processor.md

phase.description: Current planning phase for granular tracking

phase_history.description: Timestamped record of phase transitions. Logged at each gate approval.

examples: Design grounded: 12 types mapped, 3 config patterns reused
Structure approved: 6 chunks, vertical slices, no orphan plumbing
Details approved after 2 revision rounds (3 user edits)

edit_history.description: User-requested changes to the plan. Core section for auditability. Captures structural changes (chunk boundary moves, task additions/removals, scope changes) at the time they happen. Does NOT include cosmetic wording changes.

examples: edit-001
edit-002

gate.description: Which approval gate this edit occurred at

examples: Move GPU warp from chunk-02 to chunk-04

user_reasoning.description: Why the user requested this change, if stated
examples: chunk-02 is too large, warp depends on planner output

chunks_affected.description: Which chunk IDs were affected by this edit
examples: chunk-02
chunk-04

change_summary.description: What actually changed in the plan
examples: Removed 'perspective warp on GPU' from chunk-02, added to chunk-04 after planner functions

deviates_from_design.description: Whether this edit departs from the design document

design_doc_said.description: What the design doc specifies (only when deviates_from_design is true)
examples: CLAHE applied as part of gain normalization (section 4.2)

plan_instead.description: What the plan does instead (only when deviates_from_design is true)
examples: CLAHE as separate post-gain stage with configurable clip range and tile sizes

design_deviations.description: Planner-initiated departures from the design document. User-requested deviations are tracked in edit_history with deviates_from_design=true; this section is for deviations the planner discovers independently.

files_created.description: Plan files produced during this session

path.description: Relative file path from project root

decisions_made.description: Architectural decisions made during planning. Consumed by chunk-coders for implementation guidance.

examples: Clean replacement of ops_batch_select.py rather than incremental refactor
Existing function is 400 lines with no tests; incremental changes risk breaking untested paths

chunk_scope.description: Which chunk this decision applies to, or null for plan-wide

user_preferences.description: Planning preferences expressed by the user during this session
examples: Prefer vertical slices over horizontal layers
Keep chunk count under 8

learning_signals.description: Captured events for memory extraction by scribe

resume_point.description: Human-readable description of where to resume

resume_from_phase.description: Phase to resume from on handoff

resume_from_step.description: Specific step within the phase to resume from

key_files_read.description: Files read during this session, for handoff context

pending_decisions.description: Decisions that need to be made by a replacement agent or escalated

structure_iterations.description: Number of structure revision rounds before approval

details_iterations.description: Number of details revision rounds before approval

total_edits.description: Total user edits processed (length of edit_history)
